event.title: Shooting Outside Turkish School Injures Several Pupils
event.canonical_title: Shooting Outside Turkish School Injures Several Pupils
event.summary: A shooting incident occurred outside a secondary school in the Turgutlu district of Manisa, Turkey, injuring eight pupils. The shooter, a student, reportedly used a hunting rifle and fired indiscriminately at his classmates before fleeing the scene. CCTV footage captured the suspect during the incident.

timeline.title: British Columbia Files Lawsuit Against OpenAI Over School Shooting Incident
timeline.summary: British Columbia has filed a lawsuit against OpenAI and its CEO, Sam Altman, in connection with a mass school shooting in Tumbler Ridge. The province alleges that the company failed to report the shooter's concerning interactions with ChatGPT, which could have led to intervention by law enforcement. The lawsuit seeks damages to support recovery efforts following the incident.
key_facts: British Columbia has sued OpenAI and Sam Altman.
The lawsuit claims the shooting could have been prevented.
The shooter allegedly used ChatGPT to plan the attack.
